audit_semantics.structural_only: A numbered source container whose independent mathematical payload is exhausted by nested target units plus exposition or remarks. Its prose still belongs in the chapter, but it is not counted as a separate statement gap.
audit_semantics.existing_stronger_framework: A live general result specializes to an essential part of the source unit after the analytification-specific hypotheses have been supplied, but no live result states the complete source-specific assertion.
audit_semantics.existing_weaker_or_partial: Live results cover only one side, a consequence, or general machinery; they do not discharge the source claim.
audit_semantics.none: No live result states a logically comparable direct assertion.
audit_semantics.required_new_formal_assembly: A new local definition, construction, or lemma is required in gaga.tex, but its proof is a deterministic assembly of live general Stacks results and already-planned earlier GAGA analytic inputs.
audit_semantics.required_new_core_theorem: A genuinely new GAGA comparison theorem is required; the current tree contains neither it nor a stronger result.
audit_semantics.true_gap_definition: Count every non-structural sealed unit for which no current exact or stronger source-specific result discharges the claim. Formal assembly gaps and core theorem gaps both count.

unit_decisions.source_claim: Introduce the inverse-image sheaf on X^an, the structural map from inverse-image regular functions to holomorphic functions, the scalar-extension functor F -> F^an, its canonical unit map, functoriality on morphisms, and the ideal-sheaf consequence surrounding Definition 2 and Proposition 10.
unit_decisions.rationale: Definition 2 and Proposition 10 are the nested substantive targets. The remaining assertions are necessary setup, functoriality, and a formal ideal-sheaf consequence and must be retained around the planned blocks, but should not be double-counted as an eleventh theorem gap.

unit_decisions.source_claim: For the canonical morphism of ringed spaces a_X : X^an -> X, define F^an = a_X^*F = O_{X^an} tensor_{a_X^{-1}O_X} a_X^{-1}F; define the unit a_X^{-1}F -> F^an and functorial scalar extension of module maps.
unit_decisions.rationale: The live pullback definition is more general than the formula, but the tree has no complete analytification-module specialization or notation. Add the specialization after the upstream construction of a_X; do not cite etale-lemma-etale-analytification-local-isomorphism or pione-section-comparison-complex as coverage because they merely use analytification terminology in unrelated comparisons.

unit_decisions.source_claim: Analytification of modules is exact; a_X^{-1}F -> F^an is injective for every module F; and coherent algebraic modules analytify to coherent analytic modules. Consequently, an ideal sheaf analytifies to the generated holomorphic ideal.
unit_decisions.rationale: The exactness and injectivity are formal after the upstream faithful-flat local-ring theorem. Coherence follows because pullback preserves finite presentation and Oka--Cartan makes O_{X^an} coherent. No current single label packages all three analytification assertions, so the local lemma remains required.

unit_decisions.source_claim: Set up extension by zero/direct image for a coherent module on a closed subvariety and explain that Proposition 11 is compatibility of analytification with this identification.
unit_decisions.rationale: The sole independent source assertion is Proposition 11. The algebraic extension-by-zero setup is already exact in coherent-lemma-i-star-equivalence; retain the analytic notation and compatibility explanation around the planned Proposition 11 lemma without counting a second gap.

unit_decisions.source_claim: For a closed immersion i : Z -> X and a coherent O_Z-module F, there is a canonical isomorphism (i_*F)^an -> i^an_* (F^an), equivalently analytification commutes with extension by zero along the closed immersion.
unit_decisions.rationale: The live tree has the algebraic closed-immersion equivalence and general stalk formula, but not the algebraic-to-analytic compatibility. Construct the canonical sheaf map and check it on stalks using O_{Z^an,z} = O_{X^an,z}/I_zO_{X^an,z} = O_{Z,z} tensor_{O_{X,z}} O_{X^an,z}; this is canonical and avoids the source's insufficient phrase that pointwise maps 'vary continuously'.

unit_decisions.source_claim: Construct canonical comparison maps epsilon_F^q : H^q(X,F) -> H^q(X^an,F^an), identify degree zero with s -> 1 tensor s, prove functoriality in F, and prove compatibility with connecting homomorphisms for short exact sequences with coherent first term.
unit_decisions.rationale: The current cohomology chapter supplies derived functor machinery but no analytification comparison natural transformation. Define epsilon from the derived adjunction unit F -> Ra_{X,*}a_X^*F, using flatness to identify La_X^*F with a_X^*F and RGamma(X,Ra_{X,*}(-)) with RGamma(X^an,-). Naturality in the derived category gives compatibility with all connecting maps, stronger than the source's affine-Cech verification and without a finite-cover hypothesis.

unit_decisions.source_claim: Set the projective-variety hypothesis, explain that Theorems 1--3 identify coherent algebraic and analytic theories, record failure without projectivity, and factor epsilon through cohomology of the inverse-image sheaf with a warning that the first factor need not be an isomorphism.
unit_decisions.rationale: The three comparison claims are separately represented by Theorems 1--3. The remaining material is hypothesis setup and two mathematically useful remarks; retain it, including the easy affine counterexample using non-polynomial entire functions, but do not count it as a fourth comparison theorem.

unit_decisions.source_claim: For a projective algebraic variety X over C, a coherent algebraic module F, and q >= 0, epsilon_F^q : H^q(X,F) -> H^q(X^an,F^an) is an isomorphism; in particular global sections agree.
unit_decisions.rationale: Finite-dimensionality of analytic coherent cohomology on a compact analytic space is only a consequence-level finiteness input and is explicitly not a GAGA comparison. No live exact or stronger cohomology comparison exists.

unit_decisions.source_claim: For coherent algebraic modules F and G on a projective algebraic variety X over C, analytification induces a bijection Hom_X(F,G) -> Hom_{X^an}(F^an,G^an).
unit_decisions.rationale: The live internal-Hom coherence and flat base-change results reduce this theorem to degree zero of Theorem 1, but none states full faithfulness of analytification. The untagged analytic sheaf-Ext lemma is not a comparison theorem and must not be mapped as coverage.

unit_decisions.source_claim: Every coherent analytic module M on X^an for projective X is isomorphic to F^an for a coherent algebraic module F on X, and F is unique up to isomorphism.
unit_decisions.rationale: The live analytic coherence and finiteness lemmas do not algebraize an analytic module. No exact or stronger essential-surjectivity theorem exists. Uniqueness will follow from Theorem 2 after existence is proved, but existence is a genuine GAGA gap.

required_content: Fix the canonical locally ringed-space morphism a_X : X^an -> X from gaga-proposition-analytification.
Define F^an = a_X^*F = O_{X^an} tensor_{a_X^{-1}O_X} a_X^{-1}F.
Define eta_F : a_X^{-1}F -> F^an by s -> 1 tensor s.
State functoriality for O_X-linear maps and identify O_X^an with O_{X^an}.
For x in X^an with algebraic image x_alg, give (F^an)_x = F_{x_alg} tensor_{O_{X,x_alg}} O_{X^an,x}.
Identify the stalk of eta_F with m -> m tensor 1.

statement_parts: The functor (-)^an on O_X-modules is exact.
eta_F is injective for every O_X-module F.
If F is coherent algebraic, then F^an is coherent analytic.
proof_requirements: Check eta on stalks and apply algebra-lemma-faithfully-flat-universally-injective.
Use coherence -> finite presentation algebraically, pullback finite presentation, gaga-theorem-oka-cartan-coherence, and modules-lemma-coherent-structure-sheaf.

production_blueprint.required_statement: For i : Z -> X closed and coherent F on Z, the canonical base-change map a_X^*i_*F -> i^an_*a_Z^*F is an isomorphism.
proof_requirements: Construct the sheaf map canonically from the commutative analytification square; do not define unrelated pointwise maps and claim they glue.
At z in Z^an compare F_z tensor_{O_{X,z}} O_{X^an,z} with F_z tensor_{O_{Z,z}} O_{Z^an,z}.
Use O_{Z^an,z} = O_{Z,z} tensor_{O_{X,z}} O_{X^an,z}, supplied by gaga-proposition-analytification-closed-ideal, and associativity of tensor product.

required_content: Use the derived adjunction unit F -> Ra_{X,*}a_X^*F; flatness makes La_X^*F = a_X^*F.
Apply RGamma(X,-) and the canonical equality RGamma(X,Ra_{X,*}G) = RGamma(X^an,G).
Check explicitly that q = 0 sends s to 1 tensor s and agrees with the source construction.
For every short exact sequence to which exact analytification applies, give the morphism of long exact cohomology sequences and hence commutation with connecting maps.
This may be stated for all O_X-modules because (-)^an is exact; the source's coherence hypothesis on the first term is then a special case.

production_blueprint.required_statement: Let X be a projective algebraic variety over C and F a coherent O_X-module. For every q >= 0, epsilon_F^q is an isomorphism. Include the q = 0 consequence.
For coherent F,G on projective X, Hom_X(F,G) -> Hom_{X^an}(F^an,G^an) is bijective.
production_blueprint.later_proof_route: Apply theorem-gaga-cohomology in degree zero to coherent SheafHom_X(F,G) and modules-lemma-pullback-internal-hom.

production_blueprint.required_statement: Every coherent analytic O_{X^an}-module is F^an for some coherent algebraic F; uniqueness up to isomorphism follows from theorem-gaga-fully-faithful.

production_blueprint.required_content: State that projectivity is essential and give the deterministic affine counterexample X = A^1_C, F = O_X: Gamma(X,O_X)=C[z] while Gamma(X^an,O)=entire functions, so degree-zero comparison is not surjective.
